capabilities: Render decklists in mtg-deck code blocks with card previews, mana costs, and rarity indicators
Group and summarize cards by type with list and grid views
Validate deck legality against formats like Standard, Modern, and Commander
Track owned copies from collection CSV files and highlight missing cards
Generate a buylist of missing cards and link card names to Scryfall
extras: Makes network requests to the Scryfall API for card data, images, and prices; supports installation via BRAT for beta versions; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of the original obsidian-mtg plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display MTG decklists as anything more than plain text lines, and no built-in card data, prices, or legality checks.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of the original obsidian-mtg plugin.
Built with the Obsidian Plugin API and Scryfall API.

summary: Renders Magic: The Gathering decklists in mtg-deck code blocks as interactive card lists with previews, prices, type grouping, and collection tracking.
